captions.title: ARGUS: local evidence review
captions.body: This recorded walkthrough uses eight original synthetic clips. The application runs without a GPU or paid service.

captions.title: Triage the evidence
captions.body: Search clips, compare anomaly curves and inspect severity, claim rejection and review state. Reference severity is uncalibrated.

captions.title: Video and independent evidence
captions.body: Person and bag detections come from pixel segmentation in this sample. Research clips use the separate DETR adapter.

captions.title: A rejected knife claim
captions.body: The authored language says a person is holding a knife. Available evidence has no supporting knife detection. Missing support is not proof of absence.

captions.title: Raw output versus verified ledger
captions.body: The comparison exposes unsupported assertions. The normal ledger keeps rejected and downgraded claims clearly labelled.

captions.title: Inspectable severity
captions.body: Thirteen factors expose raw values, weights and contributions. Unsupported context stays unavailable. Human fitting and held-out validation remain pending.

captions.title: Recommendations require human review
captions.body: Exactly twelve permitted action tokens. A confirm or dismiss records an operator decision; ARGUS never dispatches a service. Offline sample writes are disabled.

captions.title: Seven stages, one typed record
captions.body: Features, detection, evidence, structured language, critic, severity and policy each produce inspectable JSON. Research model runs use the supplied CLI tools.

captions.title: Executed synthetic checks
captions.body: Eight scenes, fifteen authored claims and two unsupported claims rejected. The policy test strips four of four deliberately invalid actions.

captions.title: Research findings remain pending
captions.body: Real UCF AUC, XD AP, independent severity agreement and VLM ablations need licensed data, model runs and human ratings. No target is presented as an achieved result.

captions.title: Annotation and adjudication tooling
captions.body: Record normalized factors, a score, action labels and typed evidence spans. Independent annotators must finish before comparison and adjudication.

captions.title: Delivered source and academic materials
captions.body: The package includes setup scripts, tests, training and evaluation tools, the project guide, review deck and poster. There is no biometric identification, live surveillance or automated dispatch.
